utterances.text: No, I didn't play any roles there. I didn't even know that they were in the territory of Slavonia and Baranja. I thought that they were all JNA. Only here did I see some documents that proved me wrong.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Further on, we have special units of the Serbian MUP and the state security, including the unit for special purposes, the unit for anti-terrorist activity, and the unit for special operations, Skorpions, the Serbian Volunteer Guards, and the special units of the MUP of Serbia and state security known as the Red Berets or Frenki's men.

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I could not issue orders to any of those you mentioned. I didn't issue them orders. I didn't co-operate with them in any way.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: The next are the newly established special police forces of the SAO Krajina, which were later merged with the MUP of the Serbian Krajina. They were known as Martic's men or Martic's police. Were you in a position to be in command over them?

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The name says it all. Of course not.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: The next is the newly established special police and police forces of the Serbian territory of the SBWS, including the Serbian national security, which was later incorporated into the MUP of the Republic of Serbian Krajina.

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The Serbian national security was never established, nor was it then incorporated, nor it could be incorporated into anything. I was not in command of the MUP of the Republic of Serbian Krajina.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: And finally we have members of the paramilitary groups from Serbia, Montenegro, mostly volunteer units from Serbia and Montenegro and the units of Bosnian Serbs, including members of the Serbian Chetnik movement, led by Vojislav Seselj. Tell us something about that, please.

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can tell you that I did not have anything to do with them. I could not give them orders. I could not make any decisions about them. I didn't even know that they were deployed in either Slavonia, Baranja, and Western Srem or the Republic of Serbian Krajina. They arrived in Slavonia as part of the JNA, according to what I knew. And my knowledge was not first-hand knowledge on it, mind you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Mr. Hadzic, you spoke about your meetings with Henry Wijnaendts. I'm going to show you two documents which we received from the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: It is 1D3032. It is tab 1126.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It says in this document that on the 4th of October an agreement was reached about a meeting with the representatives of Krajina and the SBWS that was to take place in the ambassador's residence in Paris, and the ambassador in question was the Dutch ambassador. On that occasion, Mr. Wijnaendts told you what the goal of that meeting was going to be. He also told you that it concerned the Serbian community residing in Croatia. He emphasized that a solution should be sought within the boundaries Croatia and that solution included a possible -- a special status. Tell me, please, whether this tallies with what actually happened at the meeting in Paris.

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this is what Mr. Wijnaendts told me behind the closed doors at the little table that I mentioned -- in the corridor, actually. In the initial part of the meeting, things were not said so directly. This is a bit of a -- an exaggeration or a bit of a lie about Serbs staying in Croatia. But word for word, this is what Wijnaendts told me eyeball to eyeball.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: It also says here that you and Babic said that Croatia had launched an initiative to change the borders by converting internal administrative borders into state borders, and that the Serbs in Croatia were equally entitled to change borders in the application of their right to self-determination. Was any such thing said?

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we did think that that was our legitimate entitlement and that was in keeping with what Mr. De Michelis said previously.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: It says here further on that both sides were in favour of finding a peaceful solution to the problem.

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: And that they accepted -- or, rather, that the next meeting was agreed.

utterances.speaker: GORAN HADZIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. That was my first priority, a peaceful solution.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, I ask 1D3032 to be admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Admitted and marked.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit D135, Your Honours. Does it need to be under seal?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Yes, indeed, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Under seal, yeah. And may we see 1D3033, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Mr. Zivanovic, I see we are three or four minutes short. Can you deal with this document within that time?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, we can leave it for tomorrow -- for Monday, sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Preferably, yes. Mr. Hadzic, we adjourn for the weekend. I remind you that even during the weekend you are still under oath. Thank you. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 14th day of July, 2014, at 9.00 a.m. 17 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
